cohort: 2,793 women giving birth between January 2018 and January 2019
finding: Obese mothers had a statistically significant increase in stillbirth, fetal macrosomia, and emergency cesarean birth rates, while operative vaginal deliveries were significantly decreased.
mod_finding: Obese women were less likely to experience spontaneous onset of labor and more likely to have an induction of labor or emergency cesarean birth compared to non-obese women.
